text:
sre-oncall: Heads up — we're tracking an incident in apac-sg (ap-southeast-1) around 03:00 SGT. Symptoms: intermittent 504s from edge-auth-proxy and increased token issuance latency for Redwood Private customers. Working timeline in this thread.

ops-bot: [ALERT] edge-auth-proxy 95th latency > 1.2s (ap-southeast-1)

julia: I see auth-proxy pods flapping due to connection resets to internal token service. Dumping proxy logs now.

kevin: Rolling back the last deploy (auth-service v2.14.1) in the region; I triggered canary -> full rollback at 03:07 SGT. Notified infra team.

lia: Customer impact: Private deployments using regional KMS auth are seeing delays while token requests retry. No hosted API customers affected. Support queue has ~12 open tickets referencing timeouts.

platform-eng: Implemented mitigation: 1) rollback complete, 2) increased token-service replicas by +50% in ap-southeast-1, 3) set client retry window to linear backoff 50ms -> 1s to avoid thundering retries. Early metrics show token issuance latency down ~45%.

sre-oncall: Root cause initial hypothesis: a dependency change in auth-service caused a connection pool leak under certain TLS renegotiation patterns. We're replicating locally.

julia: Log snippets: 
```
2026-03-05T03:01:11+08:00 WARN proxy: upstream connection reset by peer id=token-service-3
2026-03-05T03:02:03+08:00 ERROR auth: pool exhausted, waiters=128
2026-03-05T03:04:12+08:00 INFO rollback: deploy auth-service:v2.14.0 restored
```

kevin: Follow-ups: replace client TLS stack to use pooled sessions, add metrics for connection pool waiters, and add a preflight test that simulates TLS renegotiation churn.

lia: Support action: sending bulk notice to affected Private customers, offering priority assist. Draft customer message ready for review.

support-bot: [TICKET] #4589 assigned to @lia - customer experiencing token timeouts in sg region

platform-eng: Current status: partially mitigated. Token issuance error rate reduced from ~9% -> 1.8% in last 20 minutes. Monitoring for 1 hour.

sre-oncall: ETA to normal: 30-60 minutes for queued token requests to clear. Postmortem owner: @kevin - please lead RCA and remediation.

kevin: Acknowledged. I'll open postmortem and include action items: TLS stack update, connection pool instrumentation, and deploy preflight. Target report: 48 hours.

lia: I'll sync with CS on any escalations and publish the status page update at 03:25 SGT.

sre-oncall: Thanks team. Keep updates short here. If anything regresses, escalate to pager duty.

ops-bot: [LINKS] Incident runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/auth-proxy.md | Status draft: https://status.redwood.infra/incidents/1720507200-preview
